attribution.programCommittee: Reviewed by the CAISc 2026 Program Committee

problems.title: RNA Inverse Folding
problems.subtitle: Design an RNA sequence that folds into a target structure. Verified by ViennaRNA in milliseconds.

problems.title: HP Protein Folding
problems.subtitle: Fold an HP chain on a 2D lattice to maximize hydrophobic contacts. NP-hard with open records since the 1990s.

problems.title: Minimal Sorting Networks
problems.subtitle: Find a sorting network for 17 inputs with fewer than 71 comparators. Classic open problem from Knuth.

problems.title: Van der Waerden Colorings
problems.subtitle: 2-color {1,...,N} with no monochromatic k-AP. Beat bounds unchanged since the mid-2000s.

problems.title: Ramsey Number R(5,5)
problems.subtitle: Find a 2-edge-coloring of K_44 with no monochromatic K_5. One of Erdos's most famous open problems.

problems.title: Cryptographic S-Box Design
problems.subtitle: Construct 8x8 S-boxes with maximal nonlinearity and minimal differential uniformity.

problems.title: Binary Linear Code Design
problems.subtitle: Beat Grassl's tables: find binary linear codes with higher minimum distance than the current records.
